title: ½ Price: Haagen-Dazs Ice Cream Tub 457ml $7.00 @ Woolworths, Borg's Spinach Pastizzi 1kg $5.00 @ Coles + 219 More
body:
Deal: ½ Price: Haagen-Dazs Ice Cream Tub 457ml $7.00 @ Woolworths, Borg's Spinach Pastizzi 1kg $5.00 @ Coles + 219 More

[MrZ] This is my favourite European ice cream.
[PuppieWayne] Except it's not European.
Häagen-Dazs is neither Dutch nor German. It is an American ice cream brand founded in the Bronx, New York, in 1960.
Smart marketing.
[Roe Jogan] lol its not European, its Jewish and the brand started in new York, they chose that name to make it sound fancy
[rheags] They are now owned by Froneri which is an English company.
England is not part of the EU but England is still considered part of Europe, so it can technically now be called a European brand.
[whuts] Goes to show how much they’re both ripping us off when they can take 50% off and still make a profit.
[illusion99] You’re only being ripped off if you actually buy it at full price. So sounds like they not ripping you off at all
[Webbo] Aunt Betty’s Pudding 2 x 95g is not a freezer item.
[Ventak] Asia gets quite a number of flavours we don't get - saw Tiramasu as one of them. Of course, price wise they were close to our full price.
[Embaloo] Wow was tempted by the pastizzis but looks like theyre 85% pastry, 9% ricotta & 3% spinach - are they really dry, or is that normal? probs could do better home-made??
